readme: Artificial Intelligence: Using Modern AI Tools
12 lectures + 12 practicals: tokens, prompt engineering, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, DeepSeek
uz: Sun’iy intellekt: zamonaviy AI vositalaridan foydalanish
AI nima, token va prompt injiniring: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot va DeepSeek'dan to'g'ri va xavfsiz foydalanish tokenizator, prompt quruvchi va simulyatorlar bilan.
en: Artificial intelligence: using modern AI tools
What AI is, tokens and prompt engineering: using Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and DeepSeek correctly and safely, with a tokenizer, prompt builder and simulators.
ru: Что такое ИИ, токены и промпт-инжиниринг: правильная и безопасная работа с Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot и DeepSeek с токенизатором, конструктором промптов и симуляторами.
zh: 人工智能：现代 AI 工具的使用
作者课程 · 12次讲座 · 12次实践课
什么是 AI、token 与提示工程：借助分词器、提示构建器和模拟器，正确安全地使用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Copilot 与 DeepSeek。

readme: 15 lectures + 21 practicals: services, monitoring, security and automation
uz: Tarmoq xizmatlari, monitoring, xavfsizlik va avtomatlashtirish: administrator konsoli simulyatorlarida amaliy topshiriqlar.
en: Network services, monitoring, security and automation: hands-on tasks in admin console simulators.

网络服务、监控、安全与自动化：在管理员控制台模拟器中完成实践任务。

readme: 15 lectures + 21 practicals: data warehouses, OLAP and mining algorithms

数据仓库、OLAP、聚类、分类与关联规则，配有交互式算法模拟器。

readme: Modern Technical Devices and Their Use

Zamonaviy gadjetlar, periferiya va multimedia qurilmalari: tanlash, sozlash va sinovdan o'tkazish simulyatorlarda.

Modern gadgets, peripherals and multimedia devices: choosing, setting up and testing them in simulators.

Современные гаджеты, периферия и мультимедийные устройства: выбор, настройка и тестирование в симуляторах.
